{{Infobox football tournament season |title = Coppa Italia |year = 2022–23 |other_titles = |image = |imagesize = |caption = |champions = [[Inter Milan|Inter]] |count = 9 |runner-up = [[ACF Fiorentina|Fiorentina]] |matches = 45 |goals = 143 |top goal scorer = [[Walid Cheddira]] (5 goals) |country = Italy |dates = 30 July 2022 – 24 May 2023 |num_teams = 44 |prevseason = [[2021–22 Coppa Italia|2021–22]] |nextseason = [[2023–24 Coppa Italia|2023–24]] }} The '''2022–23 [[Coppa Italia]]''' (branded as the '''Coppa Italia [[Frecciarossa]]''' for sponsorship reasons from the second round){{cite web|url=https://www.legaseriea.it/it/sala-stampa/notizie/info/frecciarossa-title-sponsor-di-coppa-italia-e-supercoppa-italiana|publisher=Lega Nazionale Professionisti Serie A |title="Frecciarossa" title sponsor di Coppa Italia e Supercoppa italiana|website=legaseriea.it|language=it}} was the 76th edition of the national domestic tournament.{{cite web|url=https://www.legaseriea.it/uploads/default/attachments/comunicati/comunicati_m/8855/files/allegati/8954/319_-_regolamento_coppa_italia_2021-2024.pdf|title=Coppa Italia: Regolamento|publisher=Lega Serie A|website=|language=it|accessdate=27 June 2021|date=8 June 2021|archive-date=29 June 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210629222517/https://www.legaseriea.it/uploads/default/attachments/comunicati/comunicati_m/8855/files/allegati/8954/319_-_regolamento_coppa_italia_2021-2024.pdf|url-status=dead}} There were 44 participating teams.{{Cite web|title=Coppa Italia, ecco il nuovo format della competizione|url=https://corrieredellosport.it/news/calcio/coppa-italia/2021/05/26-82066461/coppa_italia_ecco_il_nuovo_format_della_competizione|access-date=12 July 2021|website=CorrieredelloSport.it|language=it|date=26 May 2021}} Match times up to 30 October 2022 and from 26 March 2023 were [[Central European Summer Time|CEST]] ([[UTC+02:00|UTC+2]]). Times on interim ("winter") days were [[Central European Time|CET]] ([[UTC+01:00|UTC+1]]). [[Inter Milan|Internazionale]] successfully defended their cup title after defeating [[ACF Fiorentina|Fiorentina]] 2–1 in the [[2023 Coppa Italia final|final]]. It was the club's ninth cup title.{{cite web|url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/65704482|title=Fiorentina 1–2 Inter Milan: Martinez scores twice as Champions League finalists win Coppa Italia|work=BBC Sport|date=24 May 2023|access-date=24 May 2023}} ==Participating teams== {| class="wikitable" |- style="background:#D6E2B3; text-align:center; vertical-align:top;" | style="width:33%" | '''Serie A'''
